omd_component.title: Component
omd_component.description: Name of an individual microservice, shared library, or other platform element (e.g. lambda, batch job, etc). The value must be unique across the ecosystem.

name.title: Component
name.errorMessage: Component name should be starting with a lowercase letter, should not exceed 63 characters in length and can contain lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens.

type.title: Type
type.description: Expresses what the implementation of the omd_component is

omd_compliance.title: Compliance
omd_compliance.description: Metadata associated with the omd_component which identifies if the service and its underlying components are directly associated with regulatory/compliance concerns.

omd_cell.title: Cell
omd_cell.description: Describes runtime relationships between microservices. For the time being, omd_cell should match omd_service
omd_cell.errorMessage: omd_cell should be starting with a lowercase letter, should not exceed 63 characters in length and can contain lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens.

subdivision_strategy.title: Subdivision Strategy
subdivision_strategy.description: A temporary tag in now.yaml describing the runtime deployment configuration of an OMD component that defines the mechanism for supporting multiple products across many regions. At deployment-time, this strategy is used to perform releases to specific subdivisions.

supported_markets.title: Supported Logical Markets
supported_markets.description: An optional tag to indicate which logical markets the component is applicable.

deployment_strategy.title: Deployment Strategy
deployment_strategy.description: This tag helps to describe the deployment of compute resources and infrastructure.

database_type.title: Database Type
database_type.description: This tag helps to describe the type of the database

replication_strategy.title: Replication Strategy
replication_strategy.description: This tag helps to describe the type of the database replication strategy

sdm_owner_email.title: SDM Owner Email
sdm_owner_email.description: The e-mail address of the WBD SDM/Director that owns the omd_component

jira_team.title: JIRA Team
jira_team.description: The JIRA team name, who owns this component

omd_tier.title: Tier
omd_tier.description: Helps to identify the criticality of a component that can suggest operational support needed for each component/service, metrics to collect, SLAs, SLOs, etc

dependencies.title: Component Dependencies
dependencies.description: A tag used for linking dependencies between different components with any type

paths.title: Paths
paths.description: The paths, where you can find specific part(s) of the component.

required.paths: The paths configuration is required for infra and database components

required.src: The paths.src field is required for infra and database components

required.subdivision_strategy: Subdivision strategy is required for infra, microservice, and database type components
required.deployment_strategy: Deployment strategy is required for infra, microservice, and database type components

required.database_type: Database Type is required for  database type components
required.replication_strategy: Replication Strategy is required for database type components

else.errorMessage: Database-specific fields (database_type, replication_strategy) should not be present for non-database type components

jira_project.title: Jira Project
jira_project.description: The JIRA project acronym and URL associated with the Jira board representing where work is tracked for the corresponding omd_component

name.title: Name
name.description: JIRA project acronym associated with the Jira board representing where work is tracked for the corresponding omd_component

jira_board.title: Jira board URL
jira_board.description: URL associated with the Jira board representing where work is tracked for the corresponding omd_component
